name: Linearly Annealed Dropout
aliases: Linearly Annealed Dropout — LAD, Linearly Annealed Dropout (LAD)
definition: A training regularization technique that applies a time-decaying Bernoulli mask to Gaussian primitives to suppress fragile co-adaptation and needle-like anisotropic structures in sparse-view tomography.
summary: Linearly Annealed Dropout is a training technique that applies a shared, time-decaying mask to Gaussian primitives to suppress fragile structures while enforcing cross-view consistency in sparse-view tomography.
